title: Design System: Slime Mold Grappling Club

display.purpose: Page-level titles only (home hero, top of a lesson plan). One per page.

body.purpose: All running prose. Cap at 65-75ch measure.

label.purpose: Tags, field names (Position/Objective/Constraints/Win Condition), nav items, metadata.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/focus state transitions (background, border, color).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button. Sharp corners, mono label typography, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.42 0.10 140); color: oklch(1.000 0.000 0); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.34 0.09 140); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.72 0.15 82); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action button. Preferred over a second filled color for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.42 0.10 140); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.42 0.10 140); border-radius: 2px; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.42 0.10 140); color: oklch(1.000 0.000 0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.72 0.15 82); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag / Label Chip
components.description: Position/curriculum tag shown on games and lesson plans. Descriptive metadata, not a filter control.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; background: oklch(0.96 0.008 140); color: oklch(0.42 0.10 140); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Search Input
components.css: .ds-input-search { background: oklch(1.000 0.000 0); color: oklch(0.16 0.02 140); border: 1px solid oklch(0.46 0.03 140); border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.42 0.10 140); }

components.name: Game Role Block
components.description: Signature component: the Top/Bottom (or Attacking/Defending, Offensive/Defensive) Player pair that structures every game. Recurs in all 115+ games.
components.html:
Top Player

Position
Sitting with your choice of connection(s) to your partner's arms and torso.
Objective
Stay as close to your partner's shoulder as possible and hold them down.
Constraints
Do not separate your partner's hands or finish the submission.
Win Condition
None
components.css: .ds-role-block { border: 1px solid oklch(0.96 0.008 140); padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-role-name { display: inline-block; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.42 0.10 140); border: 1px solid oklch(0.72 0.15 82); border-radius: 0; padding: 2px 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-role-fields dt { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: oklch(0.46 0.03 140); margin-top: 8px; } .ds-role-fields dd { font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(0.16 0.02 140); margin-left: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Physarum polycephalum — the actual slime mold — solves mazes and optimizes networks with no brain, no hierarchy, no central controller: just distributed rules producing emergent intelligence. That's the design mandate too. No gatekeeping, no credentialed authority look, no single dominant "hero" element commanding the page. The interface should feel like a field log kept by someone running real experiments on the mat: exact, unglamorous, built to be used, not admired.

This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS/startup look (gradient heroes, rounded cards, bold-CTA funnels — this isn't selling a subscription), the combat-sports bro aesthetic (no skulls, no black-and-red aggression, no macho/predator imagery), and corporate gym-franchise polish. It also rejects two opposite failure modes: precious, cream-toned "editorial calm," and corporate trust-blue — blue is the single most overused "safe, trustworthy" color in SaaS/tech/finance branding. Warmth and identity here come from a deep, earthy moss green plus the amber accent, not from a tinted paper background or a corporate blue.
keyCharacteristics: Deep moss-green ink on pure white — a field notebook, not a marketing page, and not a corporate dashboard
Physarum gold used sparingly, as a real highlight (a specimen label, a chalk mark), never as decoration
Flat by default; depth comes from borders and ink weight, never a shadow
Monospace for labels and identifiers (position names, tags, weights); humanist sans for everything meant to be read at length

rules.name: The One Highlight Rule
rules.body: Physarum Gold appears on at most one element per viewport. Its rarity is what makes it read as a real signal instead of decoration.

rules.name: The Logged-Value Rule
rules.body: If a piece of text is a label, identifier, or fixed field name (not prose), it's set in Label (mono). If it's meant to be read continuously, it's Atkinson Hyperlegible. Never mix the two within a sentence.

rules.name: The Printed Page Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from ink weight and border, never a shadow. If a component seems to need a drop shadow to read as distinct, restructure it as a bordered block instead.

dos: Do keep the page background pure white (oklch(1.000 0.000 0)) — let Physarum Gold and the mono labels carry the personality, not a tinted paper bg.
Do keep the primary ink a deep, saturated moss/earth green (oklch(0.42 0.10 140)) — confident and dark, not a pale trendy sage wash.
Do set every tag, position label, and metadata field in IBM Plex Mono (Label typography).
Do use borders and ink weight for structure; treat a drop shadow as a bug.
Do keep Physarum Gold to one highlight per screen.
donts: Don't use a gradient-hero, rounded-card grid, or bold stacked CTAs.
Don't use combat-sports-bro visual cliches: no skulls, no black-and-red aggression palettes, no tribal fonts, no macho/predator (lion, apex-predator) imagery.
Don't use corporate gym-franchise polish — no stock-photo hero banners, no "trusted by" logo strips.
Don't use blue/navy as the primary or dominant hue — it's the default "safe corporate SaaS" color.
Don't tint the background toward cream, sand, or parchment — paired with a green ink that's specifically the "forest-green-on-cream" cliché.
Don't add a drop shadow anywhere.
Don't nest a card inside a card, or wrap a Game Role Block in an outer card.
